findings.now: The transaction date opens as 01 / 01 / <filing year>, and nothing marks it as a placeholder.
findings.why: The official page starts blank and alerts 'Please indicate date of transaction on item 1.' (rules/forms/1706-v2018/validations.json:177), but the draft is seeded with January 1, so that alert cannot fire and the filename and XML carry 01012025 unless the user retypes it.

options.name: Blank until typed
options.detail: Seed month and day as 0, as the 1707 draft does, so the fields start empty and the required-date alert can fire.

options.name: Date picker
options.detail: Replace the three boxes with one date control that writes MM/DD/YYYY and blocks queueing while it is empty.

findings.now: Seven classification buttons wrap across the Part I section.
findings.why: Seven options is above the four-option limit for button rows, and the buttons run in a different order from the official radio ids (form_1706.rs:61-69 against :72-82).

options.name: Combobox
